# uptimekuma_maintenances (Data Source)

Lists the maintenance windows on the Uptime Kuma instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uptimekuma_maintenances" "all" {}

output "active_maintenance_titles" {
  value = [
    for maintenance in data.uptimekuma_maintenances.all.maintenances :
    maintenance.title if maintenance.status == "under-maintenance"
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `maintenances` (Attributes List) The maintenance windows, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--maintenances))

<a id="nestedatt--maintenances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `maintenances`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the window is active.
- `description` (String) Description of the maintenance.
- `id` (String) Numeric ID of the window.
- `status` (String) Server-computed status.
- `strategy` (String) Scheduling strategy.
- `title` (String) Title of the window.
